Within-group replicate scatter plots

Source: R/qc.R
qc_plot_replicate_scatter.Rd

For each group in meta, plots all pairwise combinations of replicates as log2(CPM + 1) scatter plots, with a diagonal reference line and Pearson r annotated per panel. The result is a faceted grid with groups as rows and replicate pairs as columns — suitable for QC reports and supplementary figures.

Usage

qc_plot_replicate_scatter(
  counts,
  meta,
  ctrl_pattern = "NEG_CTRL",
  by = "group",
  point_colour = "#444444",
  point_alpha = 0.25,
  point_size = 0.6,
  axis_limits = NULL,
  interactive = TRUE,
  base_size = 11
)

Arguments

counts

Count matrix: data frame with columns sgRNA, Gene and one column of raw counts per sample (see section 'Count matrix').

meta

Sample table: data frame with one row per sample and columns sample_id, label, group and replicate (see section 'Sample table'). Only samples in meta are used.

ctrl_pattern

Regular expression matched against the Gene column to identify control sgRNAs (default is "NEG_CTRL", which matches the controls of all libraries shipped with crisprFlow).

by

Column in meta defining replicate groups (default "group"). Groups with only one sample are skipped.

point_colour

Colour for scatter points (default "#444444").

point_alpha

Alpha for points (default 0.25).

point_size

Point size (default 0.6).

axis_limits

Optional numeric vector c(min, max) applied to both axes. If NULL (default) the range is set automatically from the data.

interactive

Logical; if TRUE (default), return an interactive plotly object, otherwise a ggplot object.

base_size

Base font size of the plot.

Value

A ggplot object (faceted grid). Plotly is not supported for this plot due to the number of panels; interactive is accepted for API consistency but always returns ggplot.

Details

Only targeting sgRNAs (guides not matching ctrl_pattern) are included in both the scatter points and the correlation calculation, matching qc_replicate_correlation_table.

Examples

qc_plot_replicate_scatter(exampleCounts, exampleSampleMeta,
                          interactive = FALSE)
